TS01 · 06:55–07:25 AM

The Morning Glimpse

Taniya wakes · Soniya–Rahul married affection · confident double-meaning banter

USER-REQUESTED DRAFT

06:55 AM. Gurgaon ki thandi January subah. Taniya ka alarm teesri baar baja. Cotton night suit mein, lambi dark wavy hair ko haath se sametkar woh bed se uthi. Mirror mein usne apni familiar, curvy silhouette dekhi, phir wardrobe mein rakhe gym clothes ki taraf nazar gayi.
Taniya: New Year hai ya annual audit? Alarm bhi aaj overtime kar raha hai.
Paani lene ke liye Taniya room se nikli. Kitchen counter ke paas Soniya khadi thi aur Rahul uske peeche aakar usse ek warm back hug de raha tha.
Soniya: Rahul, chai gir jayegi! Thoda side ho jao.
Rahul: Biwi ko Happy New Year wish karna bhi ab restricted activity hai?
Soniya: Kal raat toh wish kar chuke the.
Rahul: Kuch wishes daily renew hoti hain.

Soniya hanskar uski taraf mudi. Rahul ne uske forehead par kiss ki, aur Soniya ne uski shirt ka collar seedha karke cheek par ek quick kiss kar di. Taniya doorway mein ek pal ruki. Yeh unke ghar ke liye koi nayi baat nahi thi, magar aaj usne unki effortless familiarity alag nazar se dekhi.
Aditya aur main shaadi ke baad aise honge? Ya calendars aur deadlines mein hi khoye rahenge?
Taniya: Ahem! Andar aa sakti hoon ya appointment lena padega?
Soniya: Madam uth gayi! Gym miss mat karna.
Taniya: Aap dono ko dekhkar lagta hai morning workout already shuru hai.
Rahul: Good morning, Madam Auditor.
Soniya apna phone lene bedroom mein chali gayi. Taniya ne water glass uthaya, aankhon mein masti thi.
Taniya: Jiju, New Year ki subah hi itna romance? Gym toh aap dono ghar pe hi complete kar loge.
Rahul: Tumhari audit duty bhi shuru ho gayi? Kuch cheezein private accounts mein rehti hain.
Taniya: Private accounts hi toh sabse suspicious hote hain. Especially jab entries itni interesting ho. Aaj subah kitni baar entry hui?
Rahul: Toh audit carefully karna. Har cheez ka jawab balance sheet mein nahi milta. Kuch cheezein sirf deep dive se pata chalti hain.
Taniya: Interesting. Aaj pehli baar aapne seedha jawab dene se bachne ke bajaye question aur difficult bana diya. Matlab aap chahte hain main properly check karun… kitna deep jaana padega?
Rahul: Jitna deep jaogi, utna clear picture milegi. Bas dekhna, kahin overload na ho jaye.
Taniya: Overload se dar nahi lagta, Jiju. Bas yeh bataiye… aapke private account mein abhi bhi space hai, ya already full ho chuka hai?
Rahul: Space toh hai. Lekin late entry par penalty lag sakti hai.
Taniya: Penalty bhi accept hai… agar interest rate achha ho.

Rahul ke aakhri jawab ke baad ek chhota sa pause aa gaya. Dono ko ehsaas hua ki aaj ki teasing unke routine jiju–saali jokes se zara zyada daring thi. Koi promise nahi kiya gaya; sirf lafzon ki nayi awkwardness thi.
Soniya: Kya secret meeting chal rahi hai?
Taniya: Private accounts ka audit, Didi.
Soniya: Report mujhe bhi dena. Main bhi account holder hoon.
Teeno hans pade. Soniya ne Taniya ko yaad dilaya ki 08:25 par gym mein hona hai—ab ready hone ka waqt tha, breakfast ka nahi.

Kuch cheezein sirf deep dive se pata chalti hain. Taniya ko Rahul ki yeh line yaad reh gayi, bina iska matlab aur aage badhaye.

Rahul corridor se guzar raha tha. Darwaza thoda khula tha. Usne andar dekha aur ruk gaya.

Taniya: “Didi, aaj ka workout New Year resolution se kaafi aage nikal gaya.”
Soniya: “Aur tumhari commentary ne aadhi energy consume kar li.”
Taniya: “Main toh bas observations collect kar rahi thi.”

Dono hansi, lekin Taniya ki hansi poori tarah natural nahi thi. Gym mein usne Soniya ko Vivek ke saath dekha tha. Ab tak usne us baat ko samjha hi nahi tha. Rahul jiju ka khayal uske dimaag mein baar-baar aa raha tha. Public mein mazaak karna, abhi uncomfortable sawaal poochhne se aasaan lag raha tha.

Soniya: “Aapne fitness ki baat shuru ki thi.”

Mahendra ka phone baja—society committee ka call. Unhone use mute kiya.
Mahendra: “Achha, tum dono ghar jao. Rest bhi zaroori hai. Happy New Year.”
Soniya: “Happy New Year, Mahendra ji.”

Soniya: “Tum mujhse poochhna chahti ho ki woh pehli baar tha?”

Soniya: “Haan. Ghar par.”

Dono Tower C ki taraf phir chal padi. Pehli baar subah se unke beech ki khamoshi teasing se zyada bhaari thi. Soniya ke past ke baare mein Taniya ko abhi kuch pata nahi tha—sirf woh jo usne aaj dekha tha.

TS10 · 09:55–10:06 AM · CONTINUATION

Subhash's Visit — The Two-Set Mistake

Soniya's confident teasing · concealed theft · ownership error · episode continuity

STORY DRAFT
<div class="a02-prose">
09:55 AM.
Subhash ke andar aate hi Soniya ne unhe dining table par bitha diya. Ek haath mein documents ka folder tha, doosre mein wedding fabric samples.
Soniya: “Uncle, aaj aap logon ki koi secret morning-inspection committee bani hai kya?”
Subhash: “Kyun beta?”
Soniya: “Subah Chairman Mahendra ji gym ke bahar mil gaye, aur ab aap ghar pe. Pura New Year attendance register lag raha hai.”
Subhash: “Arre, main toh Aditya ke documents lekar aaya hoon.”
Soniya: “Achha hai. Waise mere mood ka inspection karna ho toh form bharna padega. Approval itni aasani se nahi milta.”

Subhash hans diye. Soniya bhi hansi. Gym ki subah uske zehan mein abhi fresh thi; uske confidence mein koi achanak guilt ya sharmindagi nahi thi. Lekin Subhash ke liye uska mazaak sirf teasing tha, koi personal invitation nahi.
09:57 AM.
Soniya ne fabric samples ko table par phaila diya.
Subhash: “Yeh maroon shade Taniya ko pasand aayega?”
Soniya: “Uski choice ka predict karna risky hai. Kal tak green favourite tha, aaj maroon ho sakta hai.”
Subhash: “Tumhari apni choice kya hai?”
Soniya: “Meri choice? Main colour se pehle dekhungi saamne wala kitna dhyaan de raha hai.”
Subhash: “Toh mujhe examination deni padegi?”
Soniya: “Bilkul. Aap catalogue dekhiye, Uncle. Mere chehre se answer key nahi milegi.”
Subhash ki nazar ek pal ke liye us par thahri. Soniya ne notice kiya aur catalogue unki taraf aur saraka diya.
Soniya (muskurate hue): “Dekha? Phir attention idhar se udhar chali gayi. Isliye main auditor ko ghar mein training nahi deti.”
Subhash: “Tum dono behne kisi ko chhodti hi nahi.”
Soniya: “Sirf paperwork nahi chhodte. Baaki logon ko toh chance dete hain!”
09:59 AM.
Soniya: “Previous quotation study drawer mein hai. Ek minute, main laati hoon.”
Woh bedroom ke study corner ki taraf chali gayi.

Subhash akela dining table par reh gaya. Hallway se khule utility alcove aur uske paas rakhi laundry basket par uski nazar padi. Basket mein dono sisters ke damp gym clothes aur personal garments mixed the.

Usse samajh aana chahiye tha ki woh ghar ki private belongings hain. Phir bhi usne bina permission basket mein haath daala, cheezon ko inappropriate tareeke se handle kiya aur do matching undergarment sets chura kar apne fabric-sample packet mein chhupa liye.

Reader-only fact: Ek set Soniya ka tha, ek Taniya ka. Subhash ne galat maan liya ki dono Soniya ke hain. Yeh deliberate theft aur privacy violation tha—Soniya ki friendly baaton ne iski permission nahi di thi.
10:01 AM.
Bedroom ke paas se Soniya ki awaaz aayi.
Soniya: “Uncle? Aap kidhar gaye?”
Subhash jaldi se hallway ki doosri taraf mud gaye.
Subhash: “Woh… bathroom dhoondh raha tha. Galat taraf aa gaya.”
Soniya, poori tarah dressed, quotation file haath mein liye doorway par aa gayi.
Soniya: “Bathroom opposite side mein hai. Aapka navigation aaj documents jaisa hi confused lag raha hai.”
Subhash: “Sorry, beta.”
Soniya: “Koi baat nahi, Uncle. Idhar aaiye.”
Usne sirf unke apparently wrong turn ko awkward mistake samjha. Basket se chori hui belongings ka use koi andaaza nahi tha.
10:03 AM.
Dono dining table par wapas baithe.
Soniya: “Yeh revised quotation hai. Pehle wale mein stitching cost galat add hui thi.”
Subhash: “Haan, aur Rahul office nikal gaya?”
Soniya: “Haan, bahut pehle. New Year par bhi kaam. Aaj ghar mein bas main aur meri files ki company hai.”
Subhash: “Phir toh tumhara din bada quiet hoga.”
Soniya: “Quiet? Mere ghar mein quiet din calendar pe milte hain, reality mein nahi.”
Subhash: “Tum aaj kaafi khush lag rahi ho.”
Soniya: “Happy New Year hai, Uncle. Main hamesha kisi explanation ke saath hi smile karun, yeh zaroori thodi hai.”
Subhash muskuraye. Soniya ne meeting ko documents par wapas le aayi.
10:05 AM.
Soniya: “Main Taniya ko corrected quotation forward kar dungi. Final colour woh decide karegi.”
Subhash: “Theek hai beta. Ab main chalta hoon.”
Soniya: “Aaj ke inspection mein pass ho gaye, Uncle. Bas next time paperwork complete le aana!”
Subhash: “Tumhari audit se bachna mushkil hai.”
Soniya: “Rules simple hain: files sahi honi chahiye, aur nazar bhi.”
Soniya ne halka sa smile diya. Subhash ne documents aur packet sambhala.
10:06 AM.
Subhash: “Happy New Year, beta.”
Soniya: “Happy New Year, Uncle.”
Subhash chale gaye. Soniya ne darwaza band kiya aur quotation file dining table par rakhi.

Uske dimaag mein subah ka Vivek encounter ek baar phir aaya, phir Taniya ka Rahul ke baare mein poochha hua sawaal. Woh apne choices se sharminda nahi thi, lekin Rahul ke saath hone wali next conversation ko taal kar hamesha nahi chal sakti thi.
Usne phone uthaya—Rahul ka naam screen par tha—phir abhi message bhejne ke bajaye file complete karne ka decision liya.
TS10 complete. Soniya remains unaware of the two missing sets.
</article>

TS11 · 10:07–10:12 AM · APPROVED

Chairman's Second Visit

Soniya and Mahendra · mutual teasing, permission-based brief contact, next-meeting hook

APPROVED
<div class="a02-prose">
Soniya ne abhi documents side mein rakhe hi the ki doorbell phir baj gayi.
Soniya: “Ab kaun? Aaj sach mein inspection day hai kya?”
Darwaza khola toh Mahendra Suri khade the.
Soniya: “Arre Chairman sahab! Subah gym mein milkar mann nahi bhara?”
Mahendra ek pal ke liye chup reh gaye.
Mahendra: “Fitness event ka registration form dena tha.”
Soniya: “Form WhatsApp par bhi aa sakta tha.”
Mahendra: “Haan, woh toh hai.”
Soniya: “Toh sach bataiye, form bahana hai ya mujhse milna tha?”
Mahendra muskura diye.
Mahendra: “Tum bhi na, har baat pakad leti ho.”
Soniya ne darwaza khol diya.
Soniya: “Aaiye. Lekin aaj aapki examination main lungi.”
10:09 AM.
Dining table ke paas Mahendra form rakhne lage. Soniya unke saamne khadi thi.
Soniya: “Gym mein aapne kaha tha ki main confident lag rahi hoon.”
Mahendra: “Haan. Woh sach tha.”
Soniya: “Aur ab?”
Mahendra: “Ab bhi wahi kahunga.”
Soniya thoda paas aayi.
Soniya: “Aap bade cautious hain.”
Mahendra: “Chairman hoon. Soch-samajhkar bolna padta hai.”
Soniya: “Lekin har baat bolkar hi thodi samjhani padti hai.”
Mahendra ne uski taraf dekha.
Mahendra: “Tum mujhe tease kar rahi ho?”
Soniya: “Bilkul. Aur aapko pata bhi hai.”
Soniya ne unka haath apne haath mein liya.
Soniya: “Relax, Mahendra ji. Aap itna nervous kyun hain?”
Mahendra: “Tumhare saamne jawab dena mushkil ho jaata hai.”
Soniya: “Phir toh aapko mere saath aur practice karni chahiye.”
Mahendra ne uski permission se ek pal uski kamar par haath rakha. Soniya ne nazar milaye rakhi, phir muskurate hue khud distance bana li.
Soniya: “Bas. Aaj ke liye itna confidence training enough hai.”
Mahendra: “Aur agla lesson?”
Soniya: “Woh main decide karungi. Aapko invitation milega toh pata chal jayega.”
10:11 AM.
Mahendra ki nazar hallway ke utility corner ki taraf gayi. Wahan ab bhi kuch gym clothes aur towels pade the.
Soniya ne notice kiya ki unka dhyaan bhatak gaya hai.
Soniya: “Chairman sahab, aaj aapki attention kitni baar divert hogi?”
Mahendra: “Tumhare ghar mein toh har cheez par sawaal hota hai.”
Soniya: “Sawaal nahi. Boundaries. Dono mein farq hai.”
Mahendra ne unki taraf dobara dekha.
Mahendra: “Tum mujhe phir kab milogi?”
Soniya: “Society meeting mein toh mil hi lenge. Private appointment ka decision baad mein.”
10:12 AM.
Committee appointment ka reminder Mahendra ke phone par aa gaya.
Mahendra: “Mujhe jaana padega.”
Soniya: “Toh jaiye. Warna Chairman sahab khud late mark ho jayenge.”
Darwaze par Soniya ne ek aakhri smile di.
Soniya: “Aur haan—agli baar form se zyada interesting conversation lekar aana.”
Mahendra chale gaye.
Soniya ne darwaza band kiya. Uske chehre par ab bhi muskurahat thi. Usne Rahul ki chat kholi aur ek private, flirtatious selfie ke saath message likha:
Soniya: “Aaj tumhari bahut yaad aa rahi hai. Free hote hi call karna. ❤️”
Phone side mein rakhkar woh apne kaam mein lag gayi.
TS11 — Scene end.
